ddl.value:
"tipe" <> 'setor' OR (
        "jumlah" > 0
        AND "reverses_id" IS NULL
        AND (
          ("path_foto" IS NULL AND "hash_foto" IS NULL)
          OR ("path_foto" IS NOT NULL AND "hash_foto" IS NOT NULL)
        )
      )
ddl.name: transactions_setor_valid

ddl.value:
"tipe" <> 'koreksi' OR (
        "reverses_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "catatan" IS NOT NULL
        AND btrim("catatan") <> ''
      )
ddl.name: transactions_koreksi_valid

ddl.value:
"tipe" <> 'penyesuaian' OR (
        "reverses_id" IS NULL
        AND "path_foto" IS NULL
        AND "hash_foto" IS NULL
        AND "catatan" IS NOT NULL
        AND btrim("catatan") <> ''
      )
ddl.name: transactions_penyesuaian_valid
